findings.title: Managed indicator trusts inherited env var
findings.problem: isManagedSession returns Boolean(env.CODEMIE_SESSION_ID). A plain claude started from a shell inheriting CODEMIE_SESSION_ID from a managed session, or a whitespace-only value, counts as managed.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: requires a nested shell inside a managed session while the injected statusLine entry is still present in settings.json (it is injected and removed per managed session). Same discriminator as launchMode() in routing.ts, so behavior is consistent. Cosmetic indicator only.

fix.change: isManagedSession trims CODEMIE_SESSION_ID so whitespace-only is not managed
fix.test: statusline.test.ts: is false when CODEMIE_SESSION_ID is whitespace only

disposition.rationale: user chose fix-now: trim whitespace-only CODEMIE_SESSION_ID
